title: Deret ji njëkka tuuru ci ñee
intro: Xalaatal jamonoy nit ñi, jamono yi àdduna bi yépp nekkoon benn njaboot. Yaa ngi xool ñuy teg ñaari sarax ci kanamu Yàlla, benn bi ñu nangu, beneen bi ñu bañ. Ci ñeel dafay sax ci xol, te dafay wax luy tiital ci mer. Li ci topp dina bàyyi màndarga ci taarix ba fàww, ba ci picc mu ndaw sax dina nekk jàngalekat.
clues: Man maa bokk ci famiy bi njëkka am ci kaw suuf.
Ma jox Yàlla sarax, waaye sama sarax nangu wuñu ko, beneen sarax bi nanguwul.
Ma wax loolu ndax ci ñee, ba noppi ni damay ray nit.
Maa njëkka ray nit ci kaw suuf te amul yoon.
Ma gis korney di xasan suuf ngir wan ma ni ñuy nëbbee néew.
Ma réccu lool, ma bokk ci ñi ñàkk li samay loxo def.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
